body:
I've been interested in searching for plants that could work as good subjects of meditation or act as a "steroids" for it, and found wild dagga came up. From other reports it seemed to have a stimulating relaxation to it, which I thought was the perfect mindset for meditation. So I bought an extract of it online and gave it a go.
8:30 am 1-2 hits: No noticeable effects, maybe lightheadedness but I'll pass that off as the effects of smoke inhalation. I leave to do some errands.
11:00 am: Felt unusually comfortable in the grocery store, as though I never left my house. There might have been a head buzz, but it wasn't obvious enough to discriminate. I also had a good conversation at lunch, though there was a sense of shakiness of stimulation.
1:00 am 3-4 hits: Still no immediate effects.
5:00 pm: I wake up from a nap and a similar feeling I get when I've smoked weed is occurring, time alteration. When moving around, my body and mind take a few seconds to recognize what changed, similar to a lapse in memory but as though my body experiences an aha moment of where I moved. Clear headed, no muddled thinking.
Clear headed, no muddled thinking.
I feel chill without any drowsiness. Weird short term memory/sense of time effects.
My assumption is that as the dosage scales, this time sense adjustment scales in a similar fashion to weed as its most obvious effect. Very interesting plant. Will continue to smoke to find out its tolerance.
